# `aitbc governance status`

Show the global status of the governance system.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc governance status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc governance status
```
